exposure: Conization with pelvic lymph node assessment
outcome: Obstetrical outcomes (pregnancy rate, live birth rate)
cohort: 48 patients desiring to preserve fertility who had stage IA2-IB1 cervical cancer.
finding: Fertility-sparing treatment for early-stage cervical cancer resulted in a 5-year disease-free survival rate of 89%, overall survival rate of 96%, a pregnancy rate of 41.4%, and a live birth rate of 88.2%.
